summary: Sample role tasks/main.yml that installs, templates and starts NTP with tags, and a handlers/main.yml that restarts ntpd when notified; Ansible loads main.yml from each role subdirectory.
questions: What file does Ansible load from a role's tasks directory?
How do I restart a service only when its config template changes?
What does a simple role for NTP look like?

answer_card.title: Sample role tasks and handlers
answer_card.answer_md:
Ansible loads `main.yml` in each role subdirectory.

```yaml
# roles/common/tasks/main.yml
- name: be sure ntp is installed
  yum: {name: ntp, state: present}
  tags: ntp
- name: be sure ntp is configured
  template: {src: ntp.conf.j2, dest: /etc/ntp.conf}
  notify: restart ntpd
  tags: ntp
- name: be sure ntpd is running and enabled
  ansible.builtin.service: {name: ntpd, state: started, enabled: true}
  tags: ntp

# roles/common/handlers/main.yml
- name: restart ntpd
  ansible.builtin.service: {name: ntpd, state: restarted}
```

Handlers run at the end of the play, only when notified by a changed task.
